offer.text: My parent grows frail and forgets to eat. Would you carry six loaves of bread to them yourself, and see they take a proper meal?

accept.text: Bless you. You'll find them near home, slow as they move these days.

decline.text: I'll go myself when I can get away, then.

in_progress.text: Have you reached my parent with that bread?

ready.text: They ate? Truly ate? Oh, what a weight off me.

complete.text: You fed my parent when I couldn't be there. That is no small kindness.
